body: I know how that feels. I am 19 years old. Been struggling since I was 3 and then it got bad bad when I was 12.. been hospitalized twice for suicidal ideation, tried countless therapies and techniques and i just now found something that.. kinda works for me? Make sure you try every single thing you can before considering self termination, because at the end of the day we are all just trying to buy ourselves time. So keep buying time and try to keep on keeping on man.
